name: How much does it cost to build an ADU in Southern California?

mainEntity.name: How much does it cost to build an ADU in Southern California?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of building an ADU varies significantly based on its size, type (attached, detached, garage conversion), materials, finishes, and site preparation needs. A basic garage conversion might start around $80,000 to $120,000, while a new detached ADU can range from $150,000 to over $300,000. These figures are estimates, and a detailed quote requires an on-site evaluation and design discussion. Permitting fees and utility connections also contribute to the overall project cost.
acceptedAnswer.description: Costs vary widely based on ADU type, size, and finishes. Garage conversions may start around $80,000, while new detached units can exceed $150,000.
